quests.instruction: Which shape matches a slice of juicy watermelon cut on the diagonal?
quests.hint: Think of a shape that narrows to one point at the top.
quests.explanation: A watermelon wedge has three straight sides meeting at three points, just like a triangle!
quests.funFact: No matter how big or small a triangle is, it always has exactly three sides.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a spinning hula hoop around someone's waist?
quests.hint: Think of a shape that loops all the way around with no beginning or end.
quests.explanation: A hula hoop is round all the way around with no corners, just like a circle!
quests.funFact: A circle has no start or end — you could trace its edge forever and never hit a corner.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a bed with a fluffy pillow at the top?
quests.hint: Think of a shape longer on two sides, with four straight corners.
quests.explanation: A bed is much longer than it is wide, with four corners, just like a rectangle!
quests.funFact: Rectangles come in many sizes, from tiny stickers to giant beds.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a single dice face with dots on it?
quests.hint: Think of a shape with four equal sides, like a perfect little box.
quests.explanation: Each face of a dice has four equal sides and four corners, just like a square!
quests.funFact: Every face on a cube-shaped dice is a perfect square.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches the roof on top of a small house drawing?
quests.hint: Think of a shape that slants up from two sides to meet at one point.
quests.explanation: A house roof slants up on two sides to a single point, just like a triangle!
quests.funFact: Triangle roofs help rain slide right off instead of pooling on top.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a shiny button sewn onto a coat?
quests.hint: Think of a shape with a smooth round edge and no straight lines.
quests.explanation: A button is round all the way around with no corners, just like a circle!
quests.funFact: Round buttons slide easily through buttonholes because they have no corners to catch.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a wide welcome mat outside a front door?
quests.hint: Think of a shape with two long sides and two shorter sides.
quests.explanation: A welcome mat is longer on two sides than the other two, just like a rectangle!
quests.funFact: Rectangles are great for mats and rugs because they fit neatly along a floor.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a sticky note stuck to a fridge?
quests.hint: Think of a shape where every side matches perfectly.
quests.explanation: A sticky note has four equal sides and four corners, just like a square!
quests.funFact: Many sticky notes are cut into perfect squares so they stack neatly.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a wedge of cheese on a snack plate?
quests.hint: Think of a shape with three flat sides meeting at three sharp points.
quests.explanation: A cheese wedge has three straight sides meeting at three corners, just like a triangle!
quests.funFact: A triangle is the only shape that can't wobble or change shape once its sides are fixed.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a round lollipop on a stick?
quests.hint: Think of a shape that is round on every side, with no flat parts.
quests.explanation: A lollipop is perfectly round with no straight edges, just like a circle!
quests.funFact: A circle looks exactly the same from every angle you look at it.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a domino tile with dots on each half?
quests.hint: Think of a shape twice as long as it is wide, with four corners.
quests.explanation: A domino tile is longer than it is wide, with four straight corners, just like a rectangle!
quests.funFact: Dominoes are shaped like rectangles so two halves can sit side by side.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a picture frame that is exactly as wide as it is tall?
quests.hint: Think of a shape where the top, bottom, and both sides all match.
quests.explanation: This picture frame is exactly as wide as it is tall, with four equal sides, just like a square!
quests.funFact: A square frame looks the same whether you hang it straight or turn it sideways.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a smooth egg resting in a nest?
quests.hint: Think of a shape like a stretched-out circle, longer on one side.
quests.explanation: An egg is round but stretched a little longer on one end, just like an oval!
quests.funFact: An oval looks like a circle that got gently squeezed on two sides.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a colorful flag on a sailboat mast?
quests.hint: Think of a shape with three points, wide at one end and narrow at the other.
quests.explanation: This flag comes to a point with three straight sides, just like a triangle!
quests.funFact: Triangle flags flutter easily in the wind because of their pointed shape.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a coaster sitting under a cup?
quests.hint: Think of a shape with four sides that are all exactly equal.
quests.explanation: This coaster has four equal sides and four corners, just like a square!
quests.funFact: Square coasters fit neatly under square or round cups alike.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a rugby ball thrown across the field?
quests.hint: Think of a shape that is round but longer in the middle than at the ends.
quests.explanation: A rugby ball is rounded but longer in the middle, just like an oval!
quests.funFact: Oval-shaped balls bounce in surprising directions because they aren't perfectly round.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a full moon glowing in the night sky?
quests.hint: Think of a shape that is round all over with a smooth edge.
quests.explanation: A full moon looks perfectly round in the sky, just like a circle!
quests.funFact: The moon only looks like a full circle for a few nights each month.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a wide classroom whiteboard?
quests.hint: Think of a shape much wider than it is tall, with four corners.
quests.explanation: A whiteboard is much wider than it is tall, with four corners, just like a rectangle!
quests.funFact: Rectangles give teachers lots of wide space to write across.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a twinkling star spotted in the night sky?
quests.hint: Think of a shape with five sharp points spreading out from the middle.
quests.explanation: This shape has five points spreading out from the center, just like a star!
quests.funFact: Real stars are actually giant balls of glowing gas, but we draw them with points.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a folded handkerchief with four matching corners?
quests.hint: Think of a shape where every side is exactly the same length.
quests.explanation: A folded handkerchief has four equal sides and four corners, just like a square!
quests.funFact: You can fold a square in half and the two halves will always match perfectly.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a triangle-shaped bookmark peeking from a book?
quests.hint: Think of a shape with three straight sides and three sharp corners.
quests.explanation: This bookmark has three straight sides meeting at three points, just like a triangle!
quests.funFact: Folding a square corner down can make a small triangle bookmark.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a round manhole cover in the street?
quests.hint: Think of a shape that can never fall through its own opening.
quests.explanation: A manhole cover is round all over with no corners, just like a circle!
quests.funFact: Manhole covers are made round so they can never accidentally slip through their own hole.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a gold sheriff's badge pinned to a shirt?
quests.hint: Think of a shape with several points spreading out evenly.
quests.explanation: This badge has points spreading out from the middle, just like a star!
quests.funFact: Stars are a popular shape for badges and medals because they stand out.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a long loaf of bread on the counter?
quests.hint: Think of a shape that is much longer than it is wide.
quests.explanation: A loaf of bread is much longer than it is wide, with four corners, just like a rectangle!
quests.funFact: Bread is often baked in rectangle pans so every slice comes out even.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a hand mirror you might see on a dresser?
quests.hint: Think of a shape like a circle that has been gently stretched.
quests.explanation: This hand mirror is rounded but a little longer on one side, just like an oval!
quests.funFact: Ovals have a smooth curved edge all the way around, just like circles do.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a slice cut from a round birthday cake?
quests.hint: Think of a shape with a pointed tip and two straight sides.
quests.explanation: A cake slice narrows to a point with three straight sides, just like a triangle!
quests.funFact: Cutting a round cake into equal wedges makes triangle-shaped slices.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a single chessboard square before a move?
quests.hint: Think of a shape where all four sides are the same length.
quests.explanation: Each chessboard square has four equal sides and four corners, just like a square!
quests.funFact: A chessboard is made of 64 small squares arranged in neat rows.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a shiny sticker given for a job well done?
quests.hint: Think of a shape with pointy tips reaching outward in every direction.
quests.explanation: This sticker has points reaching outward from the center, just like a star!
quests.funFact: Star stickers are a popular reward because their shape feels exciting and special.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a swimming pool shaped like a stretched circle?
quests.hint: Think of a shape that curves all around but is longer than it is wide.
quests.explanation: This pool is curved all around but longer on one side, just like an oval!
quests.funFact: Oval pools are popular because swimmers can do long, smooth laps.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a tent pitched at a campsite?
quests.hint: Think of a shape that is wide at the bottom and meets at a point on top.
quests.explanation: A tent is wide at the bottom and comes to a point at the top, just like a triangle!
quests.funFact: Triangle-shaped tents let rain slide right off the sloped sides.
